description: Semantic constraints for Knowledge Database V2. Specification only.

constraints.name: unique_identifiers
constraints.statement: Every knowledge object id must be unique within a release corpus.

constraints.name: immutable_released_knowledge
constraints.statement: Active/official released knowledge objects are immutable; changes require a new version.

constraints.name: version_compatibility
constraints.statement: Package compatibility ranges must include the active schema version for deployment.

constraints.name: language_compatibility
constraints.statement: Language variants must declare translation_of to a base object or shared id.

constraints.name: parent_existence
constraints.statement: parent_domain, package membership, and inheritance parents must resolve.

constraints.name: reference_integrity
constraints.statement: Knowledge ID references must resolve; document path references may warn.

constraints.name: no_circular_dependencies
constraints.statement: Dependency graphs are acyclic unless explicitly allowlisted.

constraints.name: hierarchy_path_integrity
constraints.statement: Objects must be placeable on the Domain>...>Result hierarchy without skipping required parents for their type.

constraints.name: override_traceability
constraints.statement: Overrides must declare source, target, and precedence class.

constraints.name: scale_readiness
constraints.statement: Design must remain valid for 100,000+ records via indexes and package deployment.
